verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred CLAYTONI / CREATIVE AGENCY lockup with the illustration clusters on both sides, so hierarchy and brand survive. But it reads as a shrunk copy: the illustrations are cut off at the top and bottom, and there is a band of empty navy at each end, so the canvas width is wasted. B splits the lockup. The CLAYTONI headline runs straight into the left illustration, the illustrations shrink to tiny cramped clusters, and CREATIVE AGENCY is moved to the far right, small and pressed against the right figure, so the two halves of the brand name no longer sit together and the spacing looks arbitrary.
